correctness.rationale: The recursion is exhaustive modulo alphabet permutation because restricted-growth normalization gives exactly one representative of every nonempty ternary relabeling orbit. At each extension, richness is decided by the unioccurrent longest-palindromic-suffix criterion and abelian-cube-freeness by testing every new suffix factor whose three equal-length blocks could have identical Parikh vectors. Four canonical words occur at length 180 and none at 181, so longer words are impossible. All four use all three symbols, yielding exactly 24 labeled words. Direct all-factor checks independently confirm richness and cube-freeness of the four representatives, and exact canonicalized reversal checks give the two 12-element symmetry orbits.
